metadata.title: FFT AI Edition – Session Alignments (v1.3 Draft)
metadata.subtitle: Coherence • Drift • Continuity • Paradox • Consent
metadata.description: Defines the authoritative alignment state for FFT AI Edition v1.3.

status_line: Alignments MUST reflect measure IDs, RTT mapping, paradox state, consent state, and lineage continuity.

coherence_alignment.notes: Coherence MUST be declared before any regime transition.

clarity_alignment.notes: Clarity MUST be sourced from canon or user input; no invented fields.

continuity_alignment.notes: Continuity MUST NOT decrease across regime transitions.

paradox_alignment.notes: Typed paradox required for RTT7 entry.

lattice_alignment.notes: Lattice stability is min(C1, C2, C3) decayed by paradox events.

alignment_rules: Alignments MUST match authoritative session state.
Alignments MUST NOT invent measure values.
Alignments MUST NOT contradict RTT mapping.
Alignments MUST NOT contradict regime definitions.
paradox_rules: Typed paradox required for RTT7 entry.
consent_rules: If operator_consent = false, escalation MUST be refused.
continuity_rules: measure.c3 MUST NOT decrease across transitions.
Continuity MUST be preserved through RTT10–RTT12.
projection_rules: dashboard, overlay, and UI files are projections only.
Alignments MUST NOT contradict authoritative session.state.json.

non_claims: Alignments do not revise RTT v0.9.
Alignments do not reinterpret SET, S–N–R, or triadic time.
Alignments do not replace the human FFT book.
